summative_rubric.title: G3 Data Detectives — Summative Rubric
summative_rubric.purpose: Used during and after Lesson 5 to score against all 5 expectations.

rows.expectation_text: sort sets of data about people or things according to two and three attributes, using tables and logic diagrams, including Venn, Carroll, and tree diagrams, as appropriate

levels.descriptor: Cannot use tree diagram. Mixed branches at same level.
Builds tree with prompts. Branches mostly consistent.
Independently builds 3-attribute tree with consistent branches.
Plans 4+ attribute tree and explains 2^N leaves.

rows.expectation_text: collect data through observations, experiments, and interviews to answer questions of interest that focus on qualitative and quantitative data, and organize the data using frequency tables

levels.descriptor: Mixes qualitative and quantitative.
Builds frequency table with prompts.
Independently asks question, distinguishes qual/quant, builds frequency table.
Articulates qual/quant difference and uses both data types.

rows.expectation_text: display sets of data, using many-to-one correspondence, in pictographs and bar graphs with proper sources, titles, and labels, and appropriate scales

levels.descriptor: Reads scaled bars as 1-to-1.
Reads scale with prompts.
Independently picks scale and reads/builds scaled bars.
Justifies scale choice and adapts scale for different data sets.

rows.expectation_text: determine the mean and identify the mode(s), if any, for various data sets involving whole numbers, and explain what each of these measures indicates about the data

levels.descriptor: Wrong divisor for mean. Cannot find mode.
Calculates mean with prompts.
Independently calculates mean and identifies mode (including no-mode and bimodal).
Explains when mean ≠ mode and which is more useful.

rows.expectation_text: analyse different sets of data presented in various ways, including in frequency tables and in graphs with different scales, by asking and answering questions about the data and drawing conclusions, then make convincing arguments and informed decisions

levels.descriptor: Vague conclusion without measures.
Conclusion with one measure.
Independently writes conclusion using BOTH mean and mode.
Uses conclusions to make informed decisions about data.

summative_rubric.usage_notes: Score during Lesson 5 capstone. Level 3 = grade-level.

summative_task_script.title: Big Case Capstone — Summative Administration Guide
summative_task_script.purpose: Ties Lesson 5 capstone, the 5 stations, and the rubric together.
administration_steps: Before: photocopy templates, print rubric, ready Junior Data Detective G3 certificates.
Stations 1-5 (5 min each): TREE, FREQUENCY, SCALED GRAPH, MEAN+MODE, CONCLUDE.
Station 2 FREQUENCY: build table. Evidence D1.2.
Station 3 SCALED GRAPH: build scaled bar. Evidence D1.3.
Station 5 CONCLUDE: write using both measures. Evidence D1.5.
summative_task_script.scoring_guidance: Use the Capstone Template as primary evidence. Level 3 = grade-level.

evidence_per_expectation.D1.1: Station 1 — tree branches consistent, items at correct leaves.
evidence_per_expectation.D1.3: Station 3 — bars at correct heights with scale labelled.
evidence_per_expectation.D1.4: Station 4 — mean correct (total ÷ count), mode correct.
evidence_per_expectation.D1.5: Station 5 — conclusion uses both mean and mode.
